meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理生物序列、解析文件、访问NCBI数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理FASTA/GenBank文件或需要批量查询NCBI。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate biological sequences, parse files, and access NCBI databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with FASTA/GenBank files or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Biopython 处理 DNA、RNA 或蛋白序列，读写 FASTA、GenBank 等文件，访问 NCBI 数据库，运行 BLAST 搜索，进行序列比对、系统发育分析等。
howto.when: 当你要处理生物序列、解析生物文件、查询 NCBI 数据库或做 BLAST 搜索时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 FASTA 文件的序列。
say.note: Claude 会用 SeqIO 解析文件并列出每条序列。

say.text: 用 BLAST 搜索这段 DNA 序列的同源物。
计算这段蛋白序列的分子量。
say.note: Claude 会使用 SeqUtils 计算分子量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Biopython to handle DNA/RNA/protein sequences, read/write FASTA, GenBank, etc., access NCBI databases, run BLAST, perform alignments, and phylogenetic analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process biological sequences, parse bioinformatics files, query NCBI databases, or perform BLAST searches.

say_en.text: Read the sequences from this FASTA file.
say_en.note: Claude will parse it with SeqIO and list each sequence.

say_en.text: BLAST this DNA sequence against the database.
say_en.note: Claude will run Bio.Blast and return top hits.

say_en.text: Calculate the molecular weight of this protein.
